decisions.label: Tree normal maps (directions)
decisions.note: Full: trees lit from their normal maps, as ever. 64, 32 or 16: each tree atlas's normals cut to that many directions (a k-means palette, as a bake would ship them), worked out in the background for a second or so after a change. Off: every tree pixel lit flat, as if it faced the camera. Trees only; the wind still sways them. Changes live. 32 is the default (Ed, 2026-11-12: "we can see 32 tree normal maps as the default"; full before).
